notes: Calls outside this pack are cited by call site; same-pack callees (008583C0, 008590B0, 008592D0, 00859D20, 0085AE40, 0085B370, 0085BE20) by address. Virtual calls are written as virtual +0xNN of the object. Stack arguments are numbered from the entry (fifth = [rsp+0x28] at entry). 008583C0: tags 0x59444252/0x534E4F43 read RBDY/CONS in little-endian ASCII, which is why the clause naming Bullet's serialization is included. 00858C80: 01F44CC8 is a writable global whose image value decodes as 2.0. 008593F0 (2345 B), 0085B370 (2730 B) and 0085BE20 (1457 B) are stated as top-level structure in clauses; the shape (contact points at stride 0x120, 0xC0-byte solver rows, friction rows, 0x501502F9 = 1e10 upper limit) is consistent with Bullet's btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver convertContact/setupContactConstraint/setupFrictionConstraint/addFrictionConstraint, and 00859EB0/0085A1F0/0085A400/0085A730/0085A900/0085AC50 with its resolveSingleConstraintRow Generic/LowerLimit/SplitPenetration (scalar and SIMD) bodies, not stated as fact. 00859D20 looks like a thread-safe function-local static (guard 02EAF6C0, object 02EAF400, atexit-style registration of 008B90A0). Doubts: (a) 0085AC50 writes the clamped value to r9+0x60 while it reads r9+0x50 (as the listing shows at 0085AD99); (b) 0085AE40 multiplies by the body triple +0x180 only for the first entry, not for the second (listing 0085B151 onward); (c) 008593F0 is the densest row, the vector-building paths are summarized (exact component formulas are in the listing at 00859A6B-00859B61).
